messages:
Sam G: Quick ask — need final visuals for the inference benchmarks (latency vs cost sparkline) + a simplified hero diagram for the webinar. Need brand compliance sign-off and localization plan. Can design ops run a quick poll: two visual directions — 'Metric-first' and 'Narrative-first'. Aim: 3 variants of hero + 4 size crops for social. Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/launch-benchmarks Draft by EOD today? :eyes:

Ava D: On it. Can you confirm target aspect ratios and whether we should hard-stop type scales for mobile?

Sam G: Ratios: 1200x628 (social link), 1080x1080 (IG), 1440x970 (blog hero), 840x480 (slide). Use primary brand stack (redwood-red, graphite). Use condensed headline only on metric-first.

Priya (Design Ops): I'll run the poll and owner rotation. Quick compliance checklist to follow. Also we need alt text + a short caption per locale. Mei can advise on localization.

Ben PM: For narrative-first, include a two-line callout about 'cost per 1k tokens' and a micro-legend. Avoid raw numbers — we prefer ranges (e.g., 5–15 tokens/cent).

brand-bot: Brand check required :robot_face: Please attach Figma link and component variants. Missing: typography scale 3 and outline stroke 2 for icons.

Mei (Localization): We can localize copy for EN/DE/FR/JA. Need the copy strings as a table. ETA 2 days after final art.

Ava D: I'll push 2 comps per direction into the Figma page and tag @Priya. Small ask: can we get engineer mock outputs (screenshot of model responses) to put as inset? @Ben PM can you provide?

Ben PM: Yes — dropping 3 anonymized example outputs in the Figma comments now.

Priya (Design Ops): Poll posted: https://slackpolls.redwood/poll/442 — vote by 4pm. I'll also add a tiny release checklist:
- export PNG @3x for hero
- single SVG icon set
- alt text CSV
- localized captions CSV
- accessibility contrast pass

Sam G: Amazing. If Metric-first wins, prioritize sparkline + micro-legend. If Narrative-first wins, emphasize human copy + simplified cost band. Thanks team :pray:

Ava D: Noted. Will tag for brand review when comps ready. ETA 5:30pm.

Mei (Localization): tagging once copy table ready.

brand-bot: Compliance note: For external-facing benchmarks, include methodology blurb (one-sentence) and link to docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks — otherwise good to go.
